changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Paraphrase Generation' as this is counterfactual generation, not paraphrasing. Normalized dataset names and removed redundant model variants. Added missing major models mentioned in the paper.
MoverScore is correctly identified as the only automatic metric used to evaluate generated counterfactuals.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The paper uses automatic metrics and comparison to human-generated counterfactuals, but no LLM-based evaluation.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper compares automatically generated counterfactuals to human-generated ones from previous work, but does not conduct new human evaluations.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on automatically generating counterfactual examples for sentiment analysis data augmentation. The main NLG task is counterfactual generation (not paraphrasing). The paper uses MoverScore as the primary automatic evaluation metric and compares performance against human-generated counterfactuals from prior work, but does not conduct new human evaluations or use LLMs as judges.
